Birmingham Local Biz Support

A free directory for West Midlands businesses, founded in 2021, so local trade is easy to find.

Status
Live since 2021
My role
Founder; built the directory and the listing workflow

Visit the live project Talk to me about this

Overview

A free business directory for the West Midlands, started in 2021. Any local business can list itself at no cost. A publication is growing around it.

The problem

Paid directories charge small traders for visibility they rarely get, and the free ones are either national and noisy or abandoned.

Approach

  • Free to list, always.
  • Simple listing workflow a business owner can complete in minutes.
  • Local editorial content to give the directory a reason to be visited, not just indexed.

Tools

  • Directory platform
  • Listing workflow
  • Editorial content

Outcomes

  • Live and free since 2021

What I learned

A directory is only as good as the reason people have to open it. The publication exists to give it one.
